items.title: From Link Prediction to Linear Community Detection: A Finite-Sample Guarantee for Graph Pretraining
items.title_zh: 从链接预测到线性社区检测：图预训练的有限样本保证
items.summary_zh: 链接预测（LP）是图神经网络（GNN）的标准预训练目标：隐藏边，训练编码器-解码器预测它们，并将节点嵌入复用于下游节点任务。尽管在经验上取得了成功，但很少有定量理论解释为什么边级目标应该产生对节点分类线性有用的嵌入。我们在有限样本随机块模型（SBM）中研究这个问题。对于任何有界GNN编码器与对称双线性解码器配对，我们证明了一个条件归约：小的总体留出LP超额风险意味着学习嵌入上的转导线性分类器具有小的社区分类误差。该界分解为优化残差、架构近似残差以及在有界稠密区域中阶为$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{d/n})$的显式统计项。我们进一步给出一个构造性的少标签分类器：在正半定二次型$G = W Z^\top Z W$下的最近质心分类，其标签误差与LP质量耦合。该框架通过近似残差与架构无关，我们将该残差实例化为具有谱位置编码和图同构网络（GIN）及双线性解码器的$O(\log n / n)$。

extra.description: Link prediction (LP) is a standard pretraining objective for graph neural networks (GNNs): hide edges, train an encoder-decoder to predict them, and reuse the node embeddings for downstream node tasks. Despite its empirical success, there is little quantitative theory explaining why an edge-level objective should produce embeddings that are linearly useful for node classification. We study this question in the finite-sample stochastic block model (SBM). For any bounded GNN encoder paired with a symmetric bilinear decoder, we prove a conditional reduction: small population held-out LP excess risk implies small community-classification error for a transductive linear classifier on the learned embeddings. The bound decomposes into an optimization residual, an architectural approximation residual, and explicit statistical terms of order $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{d/n})$ in bounded dense regimes. We further give a constructive few-label classifier: nearest-centroid classification under the positive semidefinite quadratic form $G = W Z^\top Z W$, whose label error is coupled to LP quality. The framework is architecture-agnostic through the approximation residual, and we instantiate this residual as $O(\log n / n)$ for a graph isomorphism network (GIN) with spectral positional encoding and a bilinear decoder. Synthetic SBM experiments validate the theorem chain from LP risk to score error to classification error, and show when the worst-case constants become conservative.

items.title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
items.title_zh: MUSS：一个用于单细胞基因调控的多尺度且基于序列的模型
items.summary_zh: 在单细胞中建模基因调控需要跨调控尺度联合表示DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达。基于序列的模型捕获DNA水平的调控语法，但通常缺乏细胞水平的分辨率，而许多单细胞组学模型将基因和峰表示为固定词汇的标记，而没有其底层序列。在这里，我们提出了MUSS，一个基于序列的单细胞基因调控多尺度模型，同时保留DNA水平和细胞水平的分辨率。MUSS使用冻结的预训练序列编码器从DNA推导峰和基因水平的表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因相互作用进行整合。峰掩码语言建模随后在配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq上训练，将这些表示与细胞特异性调控状态对齐。在基因表达预测、增强子-基因连接、基序引导的调控优先级排序和零样本细胞聚类方面，MUSS相对于基于序列和单细胞组学的基线取得了强劲性能。它进一步预测任务训练期间未见过的基因和峰的表达。这些结果支持基于序列的多尺度表示用于解码细胞类型特异性调控

extra.description: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.

items.title: Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞转录组图谱的可复现量子聚类
items.summary_zh: 当前的单细胞聚类流程丢弃了大多数基因，并且在不同随机种子下可能产生不一致的聚类。我们介绍了KQE-2，一个无需训练的混合量子-经典框架，用于可复现的全转录组聚类。KQE-2将细胞映射到无纠缠的量子态，使得能够在经典硬件上进行精确的特征评估，并在量子处理器上直接检查。在理论上，我们证明了消除纠缠是局部限制单量子比特特征方差的必要且充分条件。在实践中，虽然重新训练scVI使14%的细胞发生偏移并改变了稀有类型标记和药物靶点，但KQE-2在多次运行中提供了相同的生物学结果。在标准高变基因上，仅量子编码就将发育中皮层的准确率从0.61提高到0.79。KQE-2可在一台服务器上扩展到1140万个细胞核，在十个完整图谱中的八个上优于所比较的方法（在两个上处于最佳方法的运行间范围内），并且即使在标准下游聚类下也在六个上领先。

extra.description: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.

items.title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
items.title_zh: 融合图学习与成对学习，从scRNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络
items.summary_zh: 动机：基因调控网络（GRNs）捕捉转录因子（TFs）调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有GRN推断方法大致分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整体图；基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法都有局限性，而这些局限恰恰是另一方的优势。基于图的方法因依赖单一训练图而容易过拟合，而成对方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶基因训练对。相反，成对方法忽略了全局拓扑结构，而这对全面捕捉调控机制至关重要。结果：为解决这些局限，我们提出scGPL，一个端到端统一框架，联合建模全局调控拓扑和局部相互作用。scGPL从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并引入动态的、重要性引导的子图采样机制以捕捉细粒度局部依赖。通过融合全局表示与子图增强的局部特征，我们的框架弥合了两种范式之间的差距，既纳入必要的全图拓扑依赖，又保留成对方法的数据丰富优势。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，scGPL持

extra.description: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. Availability and implementation: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.

items.title: stMIND: Learning multiscale interaction dynamics from spatial-temporal transcriptomics
items.title_zh: stMIND：从时空转录组学习多尺度相互作用动力学
items.summary_zh: 局部细胞邻域内以及跨更广泛组织尺度的相互作用共同调控发育和再生过程中的分子状态转变和形态发生。虽然时间分辨空间转录组学同时分析基因表达和空间坐标，但破坏性测序在每个时间点采样不同的细胞，留下中间轨迹和多尺度细胞间相互作用未被观察。在我们相互作用的平均场神经随机微分方程框架基础上，我们提出了stMIND（时空多尺度相互作用神经动力学），一个连续时间生成框架，从非匹配的时空快照推断耦合的分子、空间和增殖动力学。stMIND将细胞表达速度向量/漂移分解为三个可解释的算子：细胞内在程序、局部图差分注意力算子（在共同演化的物理半径内聚合相对表达差异和空间几何），以及非局部平均场注意力算子（捕捉超出紧邻邻域的远程群体背景）。通过随细胞迁移一起演化动态空间邻域，并强制内在漂移和相互作用驱动漂移之间的正交性，stMIND通过联合表达-位置空间中的最优传输解析尺度特异性细胞间影响。在蝾螈和斑马鱼基准中，st

extra.description: Interactions within local cellular neighborhoods and across broader tissue scales jointly govern molecular state transitions and morphogenesis during development and regeneration. While time-resolved spatial transcriptomics simultaneously profiles gene expression and spatial coordinates, destructive sequencing samples distinct cells at each time point, leaving intermediate trajectories and multiscale intercellular interactions unobserved. Building upon our interacting mean-field neural stochastic differential equation framework, we present stMIND (Spatiotemporal Multiscale Interaction Neural Dynamics), a continuous-time generative framework that infers coupled molecular, spatial, and proliferation dynamics from unmatched spatiotemporal snapshots. stMIND decomposes cellular expression velocity vector/drift into three interpretable operators: a cell-intrinsic program, a local graph-difference attention operator that aggregates relative expression differences and spatial geometry within a co-evolving physical radius, and a nonlocal mean-field attention operator that captures long-range population context beyond the immediate neighborhood. By evolving dynamic spatial neighborhoods alongside cellular migration and enforcing orthogonality between intrinsic and interaction-driven drifts, stMIND resolves scale-specific intercellular influences through optimal transport in joint expression-position space. In axolotl and zebrafish benchmarks, stMIND leads in expression prediction, anatomical consistency and spatial coherence. Ablations confirm the need to combine disjoint local and nonlocal operators. It reveals a regenerative transition in axolotl telencephalon 10 to 15 days after injury, with a drift energy surge followed by nonlocal dominance and local counterbalance varying by cell type in reactive ependymoglial niches. It tracks developmental vector fields across zebrafish stages.

items.title: Publications as benchmarks: auditing AI agents on spatial transcriptomics alignment
items.title_zh: 出版物作为基准：审计AI智能体在空间转录组对齐上的表现
items.summary_zh: AI智能体正越来越多地自动化数据分析，但负责任的采用需要可靠的性能评估，这在专业科学领域成本高昂。我们引入了一个框架，将科学出版物转化为AI智能体可审计的基准，并展示了其在空间转录组对齐任务上的应用。在121个任务、16个基线方法和六个AI智能体中，最佳智能体（GPT-6-Astra和Gemini-4-Argon）在80%的任务上匹配或优于所有基线，通常使用令人惊讶的简单启发式方法。智能体性能对提示和访问预安装包具有鲁棒性。基准构建还揭示了先前工作中的错误和当前评估指标中的捷径。最后，我们表明智能体生成的解决方案可以蒸馏成一个可重用的程序，在未见数据上排名前10%的基线方法。我们的框架提供了一种可扩展的方式，通过利用和压力测试现有论文和指标来评估专业科学领域中的AI智能体。

extra.description: AI agents are increasingly automating data analysis, but responsible adoption requires reliable performance evaluation, which is costly in specialized scientific domains. We introduce a framework that translates scientific publications into auditable benchmarks for AI agents and demonstrate its use on spatial transcriptomics alignment tasks. Across 121 tasks, 16 baseline methods, and six AI agents, the best agents (GPT-6-Astra and Gemini-4-Argon) matched or outperformed all baselines on 80% of tasks, often using surprisingly simple heuristics. Agent performance was robust to prompting and access to pre-installed packages. Benchmark construction also uncovered errors in prior work and shortcuts in current evaluation metrics. Finally, we show that agent-generated solutions can be distilled into a reusable program that ranks in the top 10% of baseline methods on unseen data. Our framework offers a scalable way to evaluate AI agents in specialized scientific domains by leveraging and stress-testing existing papers and metrics.

items.title: Synchronized Optimal Transport Reconstructs Coupled Transcriptomic and Chromatin Dynamics
items.title_zh: 同步最优传输重建耦合的转录组与染色质动态
items.summary_zh: 跨发育阶段收集的单细胞 RNA 和 ATAC 数据提供了转录和调控状态的时间进程快照。由于测序是破坏性的，这些快照之间的轨迹必须从独立采样的细胞群体中推断。现有方法通常在单一模态中推断连续动态，或在共享表示中整合 RNA 和 ATAC。在此我们提出跨组学对齐轨迹推断（COATI），它将非平衡同步动态最优传输扩展为时间依赖的跨模态映射，以在不同 RNA 和 ATAC 状态空间中重建耦合轨迹。我们在合成基准和四个发育数据集上使用留出阶段重建和谱系分析评估了 COATI。COATI 改善了留出阶段细胞群体的重建，包括恢复细胞类型内的染色质状态异质性，并更好地保留了发育谱系关系。非平衡形式允许推断群体质量变化，这些变化被证明与早期阶段的 DNA 复制程序和发育后期的谱系成熟程序相关。耦合轨迹使得分析发育过程中谱系特异的转录和染色质变化及其时间关系成为可能。COATI 推断的谱系响应与独立的 CRI

extra.description: Single-cell RNA and ATAC data collected across developmental stages provide time-course snapshots of transcriptional and regulatory states. Since sequencing is destructive, trajectories between these snapshots must be inferred from independently sampled cell populations. Existing approaches typically infer continuous dynamics in a single modality or integrate RNA and ATAC in a shared representation. Here we present Cross-Omics Aligned Trajectory Inference (COATI), which extends unbalanced synchronized dynamical optimal transport to time-dependent cross-modal maps for reconstructing coupled trajectories in distinct RNA and ATAC state spaces. We evaluated COATI on synthetic benchmarks and four developmental datasets using held-out-stage reconstruction and lineage analyses. COATI improved reconstruction of cell populations at held-out stages, including recovery of chromatin-state heterogeneity within cell types, and better preserved developmental lineage relationships. The unbalanced formulation allows the inference of population mass changes, which were shown to associate with DNA-replication programs at early stages and lineage-maturation programs later in development. The coupled trajectories enabled analysis of lineage-specific transcriptional and chromatin changes and their temporal relationships during development. Lineage responses inferred by COATI agreed with independent CRISPR perturbation results, and the inferred regulatory patterns were consistent with independent epigenetic data.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: A Latent Semiparametric Mixture Model for Robust Heterogeneity Learning in High Dimensions
items.title_zh: 用于高维稳健异质性学习的潜在半参数混合模型
items.summary_zh: 从高维数据中学习异质性已成为许多数据驱动领域的基本任务。聚类分析是为此广泛使用的无监督工具，许多现有方法已通过稀疏约束适应高维设置。与算法方法相比，基于模型的聚类提供了清晰的理论保证和计算简单性，但由于依赖特定的参数分布，在实践中可能受到限制。我们提出了一种新的用于聚类的潜在半参数混合模型，其中观测数据在潜在坐标逐单调变换后服从高斯混合。此外，假设潜在空间中存在稀疏最优聚类规则，我们开发了一种新方法CESME，专为高维聚类量身定制。通过允许未指定的变换，我们的框架比传统基于模型的方法更加灵活和稳健。CESME的聚类误差被证明以与已知真实变换时获得的速率匹配的速率接近最优聚类误差。大量模拟和真实数据分析证实，CESME优于广泛范围的现有高维聚类方法，包括为单细胞RNA测序数据设计的方法。在线补充文件包含技术证明、额外讨论和更多数值结果。

extra.description: Learning heterogeneity from high-dimensional data has become a fundamental task across many data-driven fields. Cluster analysis is a widely used unsupervised tool for this purpose, and many existing methods have been adapted to high-dimensional settings through sparsity constraints. In contrast to algorithmic approaches, model-based clustering offers clean theoretical guaranties and computational simplicity, but can be restrictive in practice due to its reliance on specific parametric distributions. We propose a novel latent semiparametric mixture model for clustering, in which the observed data follow a Gaussian mixture after latent coordinate-wise monotone transformations. Furthermore, assuming a sparse optimal clustering rule in the latent space, we develop a new method, CESME, tailored for high-dimensional clustering. By allowing unspecified transformations, our framework becomes substantially more flexible and robust than traditional model-based approaches. The clustering error of CESME is shown to approach the optimal clustering error at a rate matching that obtained when the true transformations are known. Extensive simulations and real data analysis confirm that CESME outperforms a broad range of existing high-dimensional clustering methods, including those designed for single-cell RNA sequencing data. The online supplementary file contains technical proofs, additional discussions, and more numerical results.

items.title: PDO Drug Screening Data for Evaluating and Training AI Drug Response Prediction Models
items.title_zh: 用于评估和训练AI药物反应预测模型的PDO药物筛选数据
items.summary_zh: 抗癌药物反应预测（DRP）对于精准肿瘤学和治疗开发至关重要。目前，大多数DRP模型是使用永生化癌细胞系的药物筛选数据开发的，这些数据在基因组和分子水平上可能与患者肿瘤存在显著差异，尽管患者肿瘤反应是最终的预测目标。为帮助弥合这一差距并使DRP模型更接近其预期的临床应用，我们使用患者来源类器官（PDO）进行了四项药物筛选研究，PDO比永生化细胞系更忠实地再现患者肿瘤。这些研究产生了用于改进和评估DRP模型的数据，包括PDO系的多组学图谱、药物特征数据和治疗反应测量。利用这些数据，我们在三种模型构建场景下重新训练和评估了多个公开可用的DRP模型：仅使用细胞系数据训练模型、使用细胞系和PDO联合数据训练模型、以及在细胞系数据上预训练模型后在PDO数据上微调。然后我们在这些分析场景中评估和比较了模型在PDO上的预测性能。此外，我们还评估了不同实验室使用不同检测技术和/或实验方案生成的药物筛选活力数

extra.description: Anti-cancer drug response prediction (DRP) is critically important for precision oncology and therapeutic development. Currently, most DRP models are developed using drug screening data from immortalized cancer cell lines, which can differ substantially from patient tumors at the genomic and molecular levels, even though patient tumor response is the ultimate prediction target. To help bridge this gap and bring DRP models closer to their intended clinical application, we conducted four drug screening studies using patient-derived organoids (PDOs), which more faithfully recapitulate patient tumors than immortalized cell lines. These studies generated data for improving and evaluating DRP models, including multi-omics profiles of PDO lines, drug feature data, and treatment response measurements. Using these data, we retrained and evaluated multiple publicly available DRP models under three model-building scenarios: training models using cell line data only, training models using combined cell line and PDO data, and pretraining models on cell line data followed by fine-tuning on PDO data. We then evaluated and compared model prediction performance on PDOs across these analysis scenarios. In addition, we also assessed the consistency of drug screening viability data generated by different laboratories using different assay technologies and/or experimental protocols.

items.title: MorphoANOVA: Dissecting Histology-Gene Expression Relationships in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: MorphoANOVA：解析空间转录组学中组织学-基因表达关系
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学（ST）测量组织架构内数百至数千个基因的表达，通常伴随组织学图像。然而，系统表征哪些基因与组织形态存在关联、这些关联是否在空间上变化，以及哪些基因在形态所捕获之外显示额外空间表达模式，仍然具有挑战性。在此我们介绍MorphoANOVA，一个基因层面的统计框架，用于表征ST所测基因的形态-表达关系。使用嵌套空间变系数模型和序贯ANOVA，MorphoANOVA评估与H&E衍生形态特征的切片范围关联、这些关联的位置特异性变化，以及在考虑所选特征后的额外空间变异。所得统计量支持基因优先级排序和通路富集分析，而空间成分图支持单个基因的解读。模拟展示了MorphoANOVA区分建模成分并恢复其空间模式的能力。应用于人类皮层和乳腺癌，识别出与不同形态-表达模式相关的生物程序，并揭示与细胞组成的独特关系。在三位HER2阳性乳腺癌患者中，侵袭性癌症标志基因一致表现出更强的位置特异性形态关联证据

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures the expression of hundreds to thousands of genes within tissue architecture, often accompanied by histology images. However, it remains challenging to systematically characterize which genes exhibit associations with tissue morphology, whether these associations vary spatially, and which genes show additional spatial expression patterns beyond those captured by morphology. Here we introduce MorphoANOVA, a gene-wise statistical framework for characterizing morphology--expression relationships across genes measured by ST. Using nested spatially varying coefficient models and sequential ANOVA, MorphoANOVA assesses slide-wide associations with an H\&E-derived morphology feature, location-specific changes in these associations, and additional spatial variation after accounting for the selected feature. The resulting statistics enable gene prioritization and pathway enrichment analysis, while spatial component maps support the interpretation of individual genes. Simulations demonstrate MorphoANOVA's ability to distinguish the modeled components and recover their spatial patterns. Applications to human cortex and breast cancer identify biological programs associated with different morphology--expression patterns and reveal distinct relationships with cell composition. Across three HER2-positive breast cancer patients, invasive-cancer marker genes consistently exhibit stronger evidence of location-specific morphology associations. MorphoANOVA thus provides a framework for systematically interpreting spatial gene-expression patterns in relation to tissue morphology.

items.title: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）用于单细胞RNA测序数据中的细胞类型分类
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性，因为存在高维度、稀疏性和转录相似的细胞类型。我们开发了scDNM，这是树突神经元模型的改编版，结合了可学习的突触阈值、监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。从Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均使用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证进行评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优独立于外部测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个中排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得了最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其次是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到了95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被视为零覆盖的技术结果。消融分析支持了树突和

extra.description: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.

items.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
items.title_zh: 解绑多模态视觉编码
items.summary_zh: 多模态语言模型应如何编码视觉输入仍存在争议。大多数模型使用预训练的视觉编码器，而一些近期方案从头与语言模型联合训练编码器或完全移除它。视觉编码器捆绑了三个设计选择：来自上游预训练的视觉先验、专用视觉容量、以及该容量在多模态主干之前的预融合放置（即在多模态主干之前）。由于已发表模型在数据、架构和计算上也存在差异，比较它们无法隔离每个选择的效果。我们通过一个受控框架解开这些选择，在该框架中我们在共同数据上从头预训练所有模型，并在匹配生命周期计算下比较它们在视觉问答和语言基准上的表现。我们发现视觉先验并非必要；从头联合训练的编码器与预训练编码器相当，无需单独的训练阶段。真正重要的是专用视觉容量：无编码器模型即使在主干按编码器参数量扩大后仍在视觉理解上落后。然而该容量不必先于多模态融合，因为在融合中添加到早期主干层的纯视觉模块与预融合编码器表现相当，并可降低首token时间。这些结果在主干规模变化

extra.description: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.

items.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
items.title_zh: AgentSSL：MLE智能体能否利用无标签数据？
items.summary_zh: 将机器学习系统应用于新领域会在标注数据获取和手动流程工程两方面引入瓶颈。虽然近期MLE智能体在自动化流程设计方面显示出前景，但它们几乎仅在完全监督设置中被研究，未在标注数据稀缺但无标签数据丰富的现实场景中接受测试。在这项工作中，我们引入智能体半监督学习（AgentSSL），将SSL框架为程序搜索问题，并研究智能体在有限监督下如何导航这一空间。我们发现，即使在弱反馈和匹配计算下，智能体也能合成结合和适应已建立SSL技术的代码，在12个设置中的8个上超过最强人工工程基线，最高提升+21.8%。然而，我们的结果将程序选择确定为AgentSSL中的关键瓶颈，当基于智能体的反馈指标进行选择时性能下降高达47%。为系统研究这一瓶颈，我们引入ProgramSelectBench，一个大规模基准，包含总计16,977个智能体生成和人工工程的SSL程序，并评估无监督和主动程序选择方法。我们进一步在真实世界生

extra.description: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.

items.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
items.title_zh: 经典能量模型学习推理比循环模型快1,000倍
items.summary_zh: 循环模型已成为推理的突出范式，在Sudoku-Extreme和Maze-Unique等简单推理谜题上取得成功。然而，这些模型可能不稳定、训练缓慢，并使用大量参数和FLOPs来解决简单谜题。能量下降不仅缓解这些问题，还提供优势：内置早停、计算适应问题难度、无需通过求解器微分即可快速训练、以及学习谜题约束的可解释权重。在这里，我们用一个学习版本的Hopfield & Tank 80年代的能量来证明这一点，我们称之为CRAM，在单GPU上训练42毫秒和132毫秒后解决了99.996%的Sudoku-Extreme和100%的Maze-Unique测试谜题，在这些任务上至少比循环模型快1,000倍。CRAM在Sudoku-Extreme上以至少少282倍的推理FLOPs匹配基线循环模型的最高准确率。我们的工作表明两点。第一，能量是从数据训练推理的一个极其有前景的方向。第二，警告不要使用Sudoku

extra.description: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. However, these models can be unstable, slow to train, and use many parameters and FLOPs to solve simple puzzles. Descent on an energy not only mitigates these issues but also offers advantages: built-in early stopping, compute that adapts to problem difficulty, fast training without differentiating through a solver, and interpretable weights that learn the constraints of the puzzle. Here we demonstrate this with a learned version of Hopfield & Tank's energy from the 80s, which we term CRAM, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles after 42 ms and 132 ms of training on one GPU, at least 1,000x faster than looped models on these tasks. CRAM also matches baseline looped models at their highest accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme using at least 282x fewer inference FLOPs. Our work suggests two things. First, that energies are an extremely promising direction for training reasoning from data. Second, a caution against using trivially solvable benchmarks like Sudoku and Maze to test the scalability of looped reasoning techniques.

items.title: Quantifying structural stability of transparent models for general insurance pricing
items.title_zh: 量化通用保险定价中透明模型的结构稳定性
items.summary_zh: 通用保险合同期限短导致数据分布快速变化，需要定期更新模型。这一过程可能产生在预测和结构上都与更新前模型显著不同的更新后模型。结构稳定性是预测稳定性的上游，但现有的结构稳定性指标大多局限于简单决策树。因此，我们首先引入函数透明性的概念，表征预测函数可表达为主效应单变量函数和成对交互双变量函数之和的模型。然后，我们提出均方形状函数距离，一种量化函数透明模型结构稳定性的指标，这些模型在精算科学中特别相关。使用三个公开汽车保险数据集，我们提出一项基准研究，展示我们的指标在识别稳定且准确的透明模型方面的有用性。带中心化数值协变量的广义线性模型是稳定的，可解释提升机（EBM）在稳定性和性能之间提供折衷。我们还发现，稳定化策略，如序贯建模和固定超参数，可以显著提高EBM和XGBoost模型的稳定性，对性能影响可忽略。

extra.description: The short duration of general insurance contracts leads to rapid distributional shifts in the data, warranting regular model updates. This process may yield a post-update model that differs considerably from the pre-update model in both predictions and structure. Structural stability is upstream of predictive stability, yet existing structural stability metrics are mostly restricted to simple decision trees. Thus, we first introduce the notion of functional transparency, characterising models with a prediction function that can be expressed as a sum of univariate functions for main effects and bivariate functions for pairwise interactions. Then, we propose the Mean Squared Shape function distance, a metric to quantify the structural stability of functionally transparent models, which are particularly relevant in actuarial science. Using three public auto insurance datasets, we present a benchmark study to demonstrate the usefulness of our metric in identifying a stable and accurate transparent model. Generalised linear models with centred numerical covariates are stable, and explainable boosting machines (EBMs) offer a compromise between stability and performance. We also find that stabilisation strategies, such as sequential modelling and fixed hyperparameters, can substantially improve stability for both EBM and XGBoost models, with negligible impact on performance.

items.title: FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification
items.title_zh: FLEX-LBP：学习局部二值模式并精确二值推理用于纹理分类
items.summary_zh: 局部二值模式（LBP）仍然是从工业检测到医学成像中最广泛使用的纹理描述符之一。然而其半径、采样角度、颜色变换和阈值对每个数据集都是手工固定的。我们提出FLEX-LBP，通过反向传播学习这些参数，同时每次前向传播计算精确二值码和硬直方图计数。直通估计器仅在反向传播中起作用，因此部署的描述符是可解释的硬二值LBP，具有90个可学习参数且推理成本不变。在六个彩色纹理基准上的受控消融中，值得学习的组件因数据集而异。一种配置在所有地方不变地应用，学习几何和阈值而颜色变换冻结。它在五个种子上将相同固定描述符的最近邻准确率平均提高3.55个百分点，在六个基准中的五个上显著且从未显著更差。使用线性判别读出，它获得0.9个百分点；完全学习的描述符获得2.7个百分点并具有最高均值。FLEX-LBP在六个基准中的五个上比五个经典LBP家族描述符、PCANet和神经LBP更准确。其平均最近邻准确率超过冻结Imag

extra.description: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) remain among the most widely used texture descriptors, from industrial inspection to medical imaging. Yet their radius, sampling angles, color transform and thresholds are fixed by hand for each dataset. We present FLEX-LBP, which learns these parameters by backpropagation while every forward pass computes exact binary codes and hard histogram counts. A straight-through estimator acts only in the backward pass, so the deployed descriptor is an interpretable hard-binary LBP with 90 learnable parameters and unchanged inference cost. In a controlled ablation on six color texture benchmarks, the component worth learning is dataset-dependent. One configuration, applied unchanged everywhere, learns the geometry and thresholds with the color transform frozen. It improves the nearest-neighbor accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by 3.55 points on average over five seeds, significantly on five of six benchmarks and never significantly worse. With a linear discriminant readout, it gains 0.9 points; the fully learned descriptor gains 2.7 and has the highest mean. FLEX-LBP is more accurate than five classical LBP-family descriptors, PCANet and a neural LBP on five of six benchmarks. Its mean nearest-neighbor accuracy exceeds that of frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters). On the Kather colorectal cancer histology benchmark, the fully learned descriptor reaches 93.8%, significantly above the best classical descriptor (Completed LBP, 92.8%). The learned radii adapt in directions that recur across seeds. Noise drowns single-pixel comparisons and illuminant change flips inter-channel ones; median sampling or gray-world normalization restores 96-97%. The code is available as a drop-in PyTorch layer at https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.

items.title: Effects of Overripe Banana Processing Techniques on the Chemical Composition and Attractancy to Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus
items.title_zh: 过熟香蕉加工技术对化学成分及对埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊引诱力的影响
items.summary_zh: 蚊媒传播的媒介传播疾病发病率上升已成为重大公共卫生问题。蚊子对常规杀虫剂抗性增加促使需要替代控制策略，如吸引性靶向糖饵（ATSBs）。虽然基于水果的引诱剂显示出前景，但不同生产方法对其吸引力的影响仍未充分探索。本研究调查过熟香蕉（Musa acuminata）提取物的三种生产技术：液体提取、糖浆浓缩和冷冻干燥，对化学成分及其对埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊吸引力的影响。提取物注入水凝胶珠中，在双选择嗅觉计测定中对蚊媒埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊进行测试。通过气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）和酶法糖分析进行化学 profiling。结果显示所有香蕉提取物均显著比10%蔗糖对照更具吸引力。在提取物中，糖浆浓缩物显示出最高吸引力（埃及伊蚊PI = 0.58 {+/-} 0.17；白纹伊蚊0.58 {+/-} 0.14），其次是冷冻干燥（PI = 0.52 {+/-} 0.20；0.54 {+/-} 0.08）和液体提

extra.description: The rising incidence of vector-borne diseases transmitted by mosquitoes has become a significant public health concern. The increasing resistance of mosquitoes to conventional insecticides has prompted the need for alternative control strategies such as Attractive Targeted Sugar Baits (ATSBs). While fruit-based attractants have shown promise, the impact of different production methods on their attractiveness remains underexplored. This study investigates the effect of three production techniques of overripe banana (Musa acuminata) extracts: liquid extraction, syrup concentration, and freeze-drying, on the chemical composition and their attractiveness to Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Extracts were infused into hydrogel beads and tested in dual-choice olfactometer assays to mosquito vectors Ae. aegypti and Ae. albopictus. Chemical profiling was conducted through Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and enzymatic sugar analysis. Results showed that all banana extracts were significantly more attractive than the 10% sucrose control. Among the extracts, syrup concentrates showed the highest attraction (PI = 0.58 {+/-} 0.17 for Ae. aegypti; 0.58 {+/-} 0.14 for Ae. albopictus), followed by freeze-dried (PI = 0.52 {+/-} 0.20; 0.54 {+/-} 0.08) and liquid extracts (PI = -0.40 {+/-} 0.04; 0.49 {+/-} 0.18). GC-MS analysis revealed that freeze-dried powder retained the greatest diversity and abundance of volatile organic compounds (VOCs), especially esters like butyl ethanoate and isoamyl acetate, which are known to influence mosquito behaviour. Although syrup concentration resulted in VOCs degradation, it also generated Maillard reaction products, such as sulphur-containing volatiles, which may enhance olfactory cues. Sugar analysis indicated that both syrup and freeze-dried extracts contained higher levels of sucrose (0.35-0.57 g/100g), glucose (21.20-28.70 g/100g), fructose (14.64-17.89 g/100g), and maltose (9.28-15.56 g/100g), aligning with mosquito preferences. Overall, the findings demonstrate that production techniques significantly influence the chemical composition and attractant potential of overripe banana extracts, offering valuable insights for the development of fruit-based mosquito lures in vector surveillance and control strategies.

items.title: Synthetic chromatin engineering for STAT1 reactivation toward restoring cisplatin sensitivity in breast cancer
items.title_zh: 合成染色质工程重新激活STAT1以恢复乳腺癌顺铂敏感性
items.summary_zh: 化疗耐药癌症通过转录因子活性和染色质可及性变化获得转录组和表观遗传改变。综合计算机分析确定STAT1是顺铂耐药乳腺癌中反复受抑制的转录因子。使用顺铂耐药三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）MDA-MB-231细胞，我们进一步确认STAT1表达和活性降低，伴随核转位缺陷，表明STAT1信号抑制促进乳腺癌顺铂耐药。为恢复STAT1活性，我们试图通过染色质工程促进其核定位和转录激活。基于通过计算机和体外分析确定PHF6为直接STAT1结合蛋白，我们工程化了双阅读器3（DR3），一种PHF6衍生的合成染色质调节剂，设计通过组蛋白H2B泛素化增强STAT1相互作用和染色质结合。DR3诱导STAT1相关转录程序，包括炎症和肿瘤抑制miRNA。机制上，DR3物理促进STAT1核转位，通过不依赖Tyr701磷酸化的非经典S727依赖机制激活STAT1，并通过组蛋白H2B泛素化增强STAT1响应调控区域的染色质可及性。

extra.description: Chemoresistant cancers acquire transcriptomic and epigenetic alterations through changes in transcription factor activity and chromatin accessibility. Integrative in silico analyses identified STAT1 as a recurrently suppressed transcription factor in cisplatin-resistant breast cancer. Using cisplatin-resistant triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) MDA-MB-231 cells, we further confirmed reduced STAT1 expression and activity, accompanied by defective nuclear translocation, indicating that suppression of STAT1 signaling contributes to cisplatin resistance in breast cancer. To restore STAT1 activity, we sought to promote its nuclear localization and transcriptional activation through chromatin engineering. Based on the identification of PHF6 as a direct STAT1-binding protein through in silico and in vitro analyses, we engineered Dual Reader 3 (DR3), a PHF6-derived synthetic chromatin regulator designed to enhance both STAT1 interaction and chromatin engagement through histone H2B ubiquitination. DR3 induced STAT1-associated transcriptional programs, including inflammatory and tumor-suppressive miRNAs. Mechanistically, DR3 physically promoted STAT1 nuclear translocation, activated STAT1 through a non-canonical S727-dependent mechanism independent of Tyr701 phosphorylation, and enhanced chromatin accessibility at STAT1-responsive regulatory regions through histone H2B ubiquitination. CUT&RUN analysis further revealed coordinated transcriptional and epigenetic remodeling associated with DR3-mediated STAT1 activation, including upregulation of HIPK2, which enhanced cellular sensitivity to cisplatin by strengthening the intrinsic DNA damage response. Finally, we investigated whether STAT1 reactivation could alleviate acquired cisplatin resistance. In vivo delivery of DR3 restored cisplatin sensitivity in resistant breast tumors. By coupling STAT1 nuclear translocation with chromatin remodeling, DR3 reactivated STAT1-dependent transcriptional programs and restored cisplatin sensitivity in breast cancer. Together, this study establishes transcription factor reactivation through synthetic chromatin engineering as a potential therapeutic strategy for overcoming chemoresistance in solid tumors.

items.title: Hypoxic Stress Induces LARP1-Driven Stress Granules That Protect mRNAs from Decay to Sustain Mitotic Cell Cycle Progression
items.title_zh: 缺氧应激诱导LARP1驱动的应激颗粒保护mRNA免于降解以维持有丝分裂细胞周期进程
items.summary_zh: 缺氧是实体瘤的定义特征，引发广泛的转录和转录后适应。应激颗粒（SGs）在缺氧下频繁观察到，但它们如何组装以及是否 contribute 缺氧基因调控仍知之甚少。在这里，我们显示缺氧通过不同于经典急性应激的组装机制诱导SGs。缺氧SG形成独立于整合应激反应，而是需要HIF1-REDD1-mTORCC1-4EBP1轴。值得注意的是，缺氧SGs在强劲持续翻译下仍组装，表明额外机制降低RNA凝聚阈值。我们确定LARP1作为这一过程的潜在决定因素，它在缺氧期间特异性促进G3BP依赖SG组装。尽管组装机制不同，缺氧和亚砷酸盐SGs招募广泛相似的RNA群体，选择性差异通过单分子FISH验证，表明保守原则 govern 不同SG状态间的RNA分配。功能上，隔离到缺氧SGs与增强蛋白表达相关，其中一部分mRNA免于降解。转录组分析进一步揭示这种保护维持更广泛的基因表达程序，富集MCM复合物和有丝分裂细胞周期

extra.description: Hypoxia is a defining feature of solid tumours that elicits extensive transcriptional and post-transcriptional adaptations. Stress granules (SGs) are frequently observed under hypoxia, yet how they assemble and whether they contribute to hypoxic gene regulation remain poorly understood. Here, we show that hypoxia induces SGs through an assembly mechanism distinct from that of classical acute stresses. Hypoxia SG formation occurs independently of the integrated stress response and instead requires the HIF1-REDD1-mTORCC1-4EBP1 axis. Remarkably, hypoxia SGs assemble despite robust ongoing translation, suggesting that additional mechanisms lower the threshold for RNA condensation. We identify LARP1 as a potential determinant of this process, where it promotes G3BP-dependent SG assembly specifically during hypoxia. Despite their distinct assembly mechanism, hypoxia and arsenite SGs recruit broadly similar RNA populations, with selective differences validated by single-molecule FISH, suggesting that conserved principles govern RNA partitioning across different SG states. Functionally, sequestration into hypoxia SGs correlates with enhance protein expression whereby a subset of mRNAs are protected from decay. Transcriptomic analyses further reveal that this protection sustains a broader gene-expression program enriched for MCM complex and mitotic cell-cycle regulators. Accordingly, disruption of hypoxia SGs reduces mitotic progression and proliferative competence during prolonged hypoxia. Together, our findings establish LARP1-mediated condensation as a mechanism that enables SG assembly despite ongoing translation and reveal that SG sequestration preserves selected mRNAs from decay to sustain the gene-expression programs required for long-term adaptation to hypoxia.

items.title_zh: 2027 年全国硕士研究生招生考试报名人数为347 万，较去年小幅上涨，考研热度要回升了吗？
items.summary_zh: 2027年全国硕士研究生招生考试将于2026年12月19日至20日举行。记者从教育部获悉，2027年全国硕士研究生招生考试报名人数为347万。 近日，教育部会同国家教育统一考试工作部际联席会议各成员单位，召开2027年全国硕士研究生招生考试安全工作视频会议，全面动员部署考试安全工作，要求各地各有关部门准确把握研考安全工作面临的形势，以更高标准、更实举措全力实现“平安研考”目标。 各地各有关部门要紧把重点关口，把牢命题价值导向关和科学质量关，抓好试题试卷全方位风险排查和全流程闭环管理，全力确保命题安全。要紧盯关键环节，加强考场安防体系建设，加强考生入场检查和考试全程巡查，全力维护组考秩序。要紧抓协同治理，联合开展专项行动，严密防范、严厉打击考试舞弊行为，全力清朗涉考环境。要紧贴考生需求，加强政策宣传解读，积极提供合理考试便利，全力提升服务质效。 https://mp.weixin.qq.co

items.title: 郭树清再度建议尽快启动「遗产税」与「赠与税」，新增税收补助基本养老金，如何解读？
items.title_zh: 郭树清再度建议尽快启动「遗产税」与「赠与税」，新增税收补助基本养老金，如何解读？
items.summary_zh: 这两天，税收领域发生了两件看似独立、实则呼应的大事。 第一件，郭树清再次提出遗产税和赠与税的立法建议。 这位曾任证监会主席、银保监会主席，现任全国人大财政经济委员会副主任委员的老金融人，在《社会保障评论》2026年第5期撰文，话说得很直白： 所得税征管要体现量能负税原则，多收入者多纳税； 要正视许多企业家不领工资、不交个税的问题，不能允许家庭生活支出由公司报销。 他建议 尽快启动遗产和赠与税立法，并明确这部分新增税收只涉及少数高收入群体，可以部分或全部用于基本养老金补助。 南方财经网（21 世纪经济报道原发）要点：郭树清，所得税量能负税、禁止家庭支出公司报销、建议启动遗产赠与税立法、税收仅面向少数高收入群体，用于养老金补助 第二件，离岸信托征税交出了第一份成绩单。 11月11日，国家税务总局披露，离岸信托收益征税90天过渡期平稳结束，累计申报个人所得税超过1600亿元，仅10月当月入库就超

items.title: 微软多项服务发生大规模故障，Outlook异常报告超13万起，问题可能出在哪？你现在还能正常登录吗？
items.title_zh: 微软多项服务发生大规模故障，Outlook异常报告超13万起，问题可能出在哪？你现在还能正常登录吗？
items.summary_zh: 11月12日，微软旗下Outlook、Teams及Microsoft 365等多项服务出现大规模故障，影响美国及其他地区用户。根据网络故障监测网站Downdetector的数据，截至美东时间13：27，Outlook相关故障报告已超过13万起，Microsoft 365故障报告超过4.6万起，Teams相关报告约3000起。微软当天早些时候曾表示，已修复影响北美用户的Teams服务故障，相关影响已完全消除。 不过，公司随后指出，故障可能还会影响其他地区用户连接Microsoft 365服务，表明此次服务中断的影响范围可能进一步扩大。Downdetector通过汇总用户及其他来源的故障报告监测服务状态，因此报告数量并不等同于实际受影响的用户人数。目前，微软尚未披露此次大规模故障的具体原因及最终影响范围。责任编辑：龙运翔 微软多项服务发生大规模故障，outlook异常报告超过13万起

items.title: 东鹏饮料开始卖酒了，名字就叫好厉害，你看好吗？
items.title_zh: 东鹏饮料开始卖酒了，名字就叫好厉害，你看好吗？
items.summary_zh: 此前，东鹏饮料在投资者互动平台表示，推出酒类产品“好厉害”主打餐饮渠道，依托现有餐饮终端网络拓展，与饮料产品共享渠道资源，提升单店效益。公司目前对酒类产品采取小步测试、审慎投入的策略，资源重心仍聚焦饮料主业。 11月11日，东鹏饮料方面告诉界面新闻，“该产品已上市，150毫升装零售价16元，并有‘4元乐享’的促销活动。”从社交平台流出的产品信息来看，“好厉害”为33度配制酒，包装标有“17种甄选原料”，配料包括白酒、伏特加及多种植物原料。产品由东鹏饮料（集团）股份有限公司授权，委托海南椰岛酒业发展有限公司生产。海南椰岛旗下拥有椰岛鹿龟酒等酒类产品。（界面新闻）东鹏饮料开始卖酒了 - 21经济网

items.title_zh: 饶毅喊话耿同学「欢迎耿同学批评」，如何理解他们两位观点的异同？

items.title: 张雪回应「读书无用论」，称这种定义很 low，自己几乎每天都学习，如何看待这一表态？
items.title_zh: 张雪回应「读书无用论」，称这种定义很 low，自己几乎每天都学习，如何看待这一表态？
items.summary_zh: 今天，张雪机车第10万台整车在重庆生产基地正式下线。张雪机车创始人张雪接受重庆广电第1眼采访时回应了“读书无用论”。记者：“现在你红了以后，很多网上都说就是像雪总这么成功，那说明读书没有用。那你觉得这个‘读书无用论’，你怎么去回应他们？”张雪：“这个很low，这个定义，我觉得我是每天几乎都在学习。那读书是更集中的学习嘛。当然我这个可能是，怎么说呢，就是不是每个人都有条件。”“就是我昨天在想，我说我身边全是这些牛人，那我天天和牛人在一起，那我和他们交流的过程中必然会产生学习，对不对？ 在学校要积极地高效地学习知识，还有就是要训练自己的学习能力。然后还有就是，学校本身是一个进入社会场前的一个训练。”张雪成功说明读书无用？张雪：这种定义很low 我几乎每天都在学习

items.title_zh: 《密档》口碑、票房均不如《给阿嬷的情书》《南京照相馆》，其导演却拿下最佳导演，金鸡奖的评审逻辑是什么？
items.summary_zh: “导演郑大圣选取小切口视角处理重大红色史实，以日常中的反常构建隐蔽战线叙事的独特张力，善用历史留白展开艺术想象，以扎实纪实影像和沉浸式现场拍摄，释放演员表演的生命质感，对红色谍战类型做出全新探索，特授予最佳导演。”评委会评语如是写道。 《南京照相馆》30.17亿票房，《给阿嬷的情书》最终20.05亿票房。 《密档》2126.3万票房

items.title: 网友称高铁座椅 USB 口充手机越充越掉电，12306 称电压更低，用于应急补电，这个设计合理吗？

items.summary_zh: 据第一帮帮团报道，11月10日，有网友发帖称，高铁座椅USB口给手机充电越充越掉电，引发热议。 记者致电铁路12306官方热线，接线客服表示，列车充电口的电压低于家里使用的交流电电压，是用来应急补电用的，如果手机电量较少或平时手机用电习惯较差的旅客，还是建议随身携带充电宝。 https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/F6lG0zytofKJJwCISbiZsg

items.title: 如何解读国家发改委称「解决养老愁、托育难等问题是我们工作的重中之重 」？国家可能采取哪些解决措施？
items.title_zh: 如何解读国家发改委称「解决养老愁、托育难等问题是我们工作的重中之重 」？国家可能采取哪些解决措施？
items.summary_zh: 11月10日，国家发展改革委奋进“十五五”系列新闻发布会，介绍增进民生福祉有关情况。 国家发改委社会发展司副司长黄玮茹说，对很多家庭来说，一边要照顾老人、一边要照料孩子，压力实实在在。千方百计解决他们“养老愁、托育难”等急难愁盼问题，是我们当前和今后一段时期保障和改善民生工作的重中之重。“十五五”规划《纲要》就优化养老和托育服务供给、提升保障水平进行了总体部署，近期，经国务院同意，国家发改委联合相关部门印发了《“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案》，进一步细化提出了13条任务举措。后续，我们将抓好贯彻落实，加快完善覆盖城乡、布局合理、价格可接受、质量有保障的普惠养老和托育服务，进一步提升人民群众获得感、幸福感、安全感。 改善养老和托育机构条件，扩大优质资源供给。2026年，我们已经下达中央预算内投资140亿元，支持各地新建改扩建了一批养老、托育服务设施，建设了超10万个护理型养老床位和超3万个
